title: Radius Monthly Membership
pay_text: Firing fees apply; $0.06/cubic inch includes both bisque and glaze firing.
how_to_join: Apply via email; applicants must have minimum 12 weeks clay instruction and understanding of full ceramic process.
source_quote: Have your work fired in our cone 6 electric or cone 10 gas kilns (firing fees apply). The opportunity to learn to fire kilns and fire your own work (become kiln certified with us to have full control of firing your pieces).
evidence_sentence: Monthly members can fire work in Cone 6 electric and Cone 10 gas kilns, and may become kiln certified to fire their own pieces.
evidence_quote: Have your work fired in our cone 6 electric or cone 10 gas kilns (firing fees apply). The opportunity to learn to fire kilns and fire your own work (become kiln certified with us to have full control of firing your pieces).
summary: Ongoing monthly membership ($150–$300/month, 6-month initial commitment) grants 24/7 studio access, personal storage, and access to Cone 6 electric and Cone 10 gas kilns with opportunity to become kiln certified. Requires minimum 12 weeks prior clay instruction.
